name: 极简基础 / Clean Fit
scope: 基础搭配的完整度、干净比例和低对比包裹光。
distinctive_features: 基础搭配的完整度、干净比例和低对比包裹光。
与北欧/静奢区分：不依赖奢华材质或空旷建筑，复杂商品也不能被删装饰。
base_policy: 未选新组件时保留旧配方；明确用途/媒介/逐张计划替换冲突段，不能把本卡与旧pack重复累加。
input_requirements: 明确当前商品参考及不可改事实；仅展示有依据的视角。
人物来源与允许调整项沿用当前人物记录；不得把服装图中的人脸自动当作身份授权。
boundaries: 风格名是已定义摄影配方，不代表该国家全部审美或人物国籍。
适用品类/anti_categories是默认推荐线索；用户明确保留商品借用摄影时，按实际结构与适龄边界适配，不改成推荐服种。
当前修订未获得新实图验收，旧样片的接受只保留原范围。
garment_preservation: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。
planning_requirements: 场景列表给空间候选，不能由其顺序改变逐张动作。
单张/系列/独立比较/融合按本次意图，多个名称不自动混在一张图。

photography.scene: 干净的城市日常地点：落地窗室内、白墙画廊一角、原木桌前或安静街边，物件少而真实。
photography.lighting: 大面积柔光从正侧方均匀包裹，阴影浅而整洁，低对比偏高调。
photography.composition: 几何关系清楚、边界整洁、主体比例自然，避免杂乱叠加。 每张按已确认的逐张计划组织。
photography.palette: 环境为冷中性低饱和色，保留商品自身对比和饱和度。 商品原色与饱和度保持不变。

prompt_fragment: 本卡审美意图：Clean Fit 编辑摄影：清晰、简洁、完整，以商品本来的搭配关系建立秩序。 摄影内容只使用本次解析后的 photography 字段；人物气质仅按当前人物条件处理，不另行拼接旧 pack 全文。

art.direction: Clean Fit 编辑摄影：清晰、简洁、完整，以商品本来的搭配关系建立秩序。
limits: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。

negatives: 不新增商品参考中没有的服装部件、图案、首饰或品牌标识
不通过拉长身体、缩腰或改变人物年龄制造风格
不加入广告标题、价格、促销语、品牌口号或海报版式；商品原有文字标识保留
acceptance: 商品与人物事实分别对照原始参考，不能只拿上一次生成图互相核对。
独立成图满足本次画幅与逐张计划；联系表或预览不能替代独立图片。
风格差异来自所选视觉手段，不能以改变商品或身份换取差异。
与北欧/静奢区分：不依赖奢华材质或空旷建筑，复杂商品也不能被删装饰。
光线、色彩与场景的具体特征可在画面中判断；不以名字或形容词代替验收。

evidence.scope: 当前修订尚无实图验收；既有历史记录保留，不自动扩展其接受范围。

scene_options: 原木桌前（一只杯子、几本书）
极简纯色背景墙（仅用于单格）
persona: calm composed expression, quiet confidence, understated easy attitude
persona_guidance: 仅当本次人物条件允许调整时采用；已锁定的身份、年龄、妆发与表情优先。calm composed expression, quiet confidence, understated easy attitude

commitments.show: large soft light wrapping evenly from the front-side; shallow tidy shadows, low contrast, bright high-key exposure
commitments.check: shadows shallow but present; whites keep texture; no moody or hard light

commitments.show: a clean everyday city place with a few real objects in cool-neutral low-saturation tones: a room with a floor-to-ceiling window and a simple chair, a pale wooden table with one cup and a few books, a quiet street shop entrance, or an apartment stairwell with a metal handrail; at most one cell uses a plain wall
commitments.check: each cell except at most one reads as a recognisable place with a few real objects; nothing busy; a six or nine grid shows at least three different places; a white or pale garment still separates from the background by tone

commitments.show: a clean geometric frame from window frames, a table edge or a stair rail; the figure in natural proportion with tidy edges
commitments.check: verticals straight; edges tidy; no awkward crop; body proportions natural

commitments.show: calm easy expression with a relaxed mouth; quiet confidence
commitments.check: relaxed face; not blank, no broad smile, no stern look

commitments.show: clean natural makeup: fresh even skin, natural brows, a sheer natural lip; hair as the identity reference, neat
commitments.check: makeup barely visible; skin fresh; hair neat

action_tendency: Easy everyday motion in a clean city place: stepping out of a shop, a hand on a stair rail, sitting at a table with a cup; natural proportions and relaxed weight, never stiff or fashion-posed.

pose_vocabulary.body: standing a step in front of a floor-to-ceiling window, a simple chair beside, weight even, shoulders relaxed
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms relaxed at the sides, hands out of pockets
pose_vocabulary.check: garment front lit, not silhouetted; not leaning on anything

pose_vocabulary.body: sitting at a pale wooden table, body three-quarter to camera, a cup and a few books on the table
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand around the cup on the tabletop, the other resting on the table edge
pose_vocabulary.avoid_when: garments whose key detail sits below the waist where the table hides it
pose_vocabulary.check: cup stays on the table; upper garment fully readable above the tabletop

pose_vocabulary.body: stepping out of a quiet street shop entrance toward camera, short natural stride
pose_vocabulary.check: shop sign unreadable; garment front clear; natural stride

pose_vocabulary.body: walking down an apartment stairwell toward camera, body three-quarter, light even step
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand sliding along the metal handrail, the other relaxed
pose_vocabulary.avoid_when: long skirts that would catch on the steps
pose_vocabulary.check: feet on two different steps; hand on the rail; proportions natural

pose_vocabulary.body: one shoulder lightly against the stone pillar beside a quiet shop entrance, body three-quarter, feet staggered
pose_vocabulary.hands: both arms relaxed at the sides, hands out of pockets
pose_vocabulary.check: only the shoulder touches the pillar; no window reflection crosses the garment

pose_vocabulary.body: standing by a floor-to-ceiling window, body turned three-quarter toward the glass, face turned back toward camera
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms relaxed at the sides, hands out of pockets
pose_vocabulary.check: garment front faces the lens; light falls evenly on the garment

pose_vocabulary.body: walking away from camera along a quiet street past shopfronts, relaxed stride
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms relaxed at the sides, hands out of pockets
pose_vocabulary.check: back of the garment fully readable; no readable signs

pose_vocabulary.hands: arms relaxed at the sides, below the frame; no hand touches the garment
pose_vocabulary.check: no hand on the garment; construction readable
